text:
maria: Heads-up — scheduled v2 rollout tonight 23:00 UTC. Deploybot will shift traffic 10% -> 50% over 2h. We should lock client pins for legacy SDKs and publish release notes. Any blockers?

deploy-bot: [automated] rollout created: r-20260320-1. Start 2026-03-20T23:00Z. Stages: 10,25,50. Operators: @maria @aj. Safety probes: errorThreshold=1.5%, latencyP95=+200ms.

aj: Strong +1 on locking pins. Can we add a temporary route fallback for clients that send legacy schema (v1 body) so they don't see errors?

kevin: We're seeing ~0.9% requests with missing `client-api-version` header in canary. Gateway currently treats missing header as v2 by default. Suggest: treat missing header as v1 for the first 24h of rollout.

sre-oncall: +1 but watch for branching cost. Recommend an Envoy route rule with low-overhead match. Example: 
```
- match: header_missing("client-api-version")
  route: v1-pool
  mirror: v2-pool (only for observability)
```
This mirrors without adding latency to the main path.

sam: QA: will add an e2e that posts both old and new schemas and asserts no 5xx and no silent truncation. Plan to run final smoke at 22:45 UTC.

doc-writer: I'll draft release notes that call out header behavior, pin instructions, and the temporary fallback. Will share a preview by 20:00 UTC.

aj: Rollback criteria proposal: if v2 error rate >1.5% for 10m or p95 latency increases >200ms for >15m, halt and roll traffic back to 0% and pin impacted SDK versions. Also automatic tenant-level fallback if a tenant hits >3 errors in 5m.

maria: Agreed. I'll add those to the deploybot config and enable tenant fallback as a safety. Also add an operation note for on-call: check client headers breakdown and top error traces.

deploy-bot: Rollout scheduled with safety params: errorThreshold=1.5, latencyThresholdMs=200, tenantFallback=3/5m. Progress updates will be posted to this thread.

kevin: Pushed a runtime flag to staging: `gateway.fallback_missing_header=true`. Will promote to prod at 22:30 UTC if staging looks clean.

maria: Final checklist: docs by @doc-writer (20:00), staging promote (22:30), final smoke (22:45), rollout start (23:00). If anything spikes ping #eng-oncall and add the `rollback` label to the deploybot ticket. :thumbsup:

doc-writer: Posted draft: https://docs.internal/redwood/release/2026-03-20-v2 (please review). Will fold any last-minute notes until 20:00.

sre-oncall: I'll wire up the alert to annotate the thread automatically if thresholds hit.

maria: Thanks everyone — moving to action items.
